ops.title: apple/container real-tun works with --cap-add NET_ADMIN (resolves userspace-tailscale reachability)
ops.body:
CONFIRMED live 2026-07-16 on apple/container 1.1.0: `container run --cap-add NET_ADMIN` grants CAP_NET_ADMIN inside the micro-VM, and `ip tuntap add mode tun dev tun0` SUCCEEDS (TUN_CREATE_OK). WITHOUT the cap: `/dev/net/tun` exists but `ioctl(TUNSETIFF): Operation not permitted` (the prototype's EPERM). So the earlier "tailscale in-container = userspace-networking only" finding ([[apple-container-prototype-verdict]]) was WITHOUT the cap — with `--cap-add NET_ADMIN`, a REAL tun works.

**Design impact (Phase 2, supersedes the userspace-networking assumption in note 54ef05f2 / doc 1d1daaa):** run hermes's in-container tailscaled with a REAL tun (`--tun=tailscale0`, not `--tun=userspace-networking`) + `container run --cap-add NET_ADMIN`. This gives `hermes gateway run` NORMAL system netstack access to the tailnet — the agent reaches metal:14322 (vault proxy) + bluebubbles:443 via ordinary connect(), MagicDNS resolves via /etc/resolv.conf (tailscale-managed, or apple/container `--dns`), and HTTPS_PROXY=metal:14322 works unmodified. This ELIMINATES the userspace-proxy/SOCKS5 chaining problem the arch review (note 54ef05f2 Q2) and the image-build agent flagged as the compound-egress risk.

apple/container `container run` also exposes: `--cap-add`/`--cap-drop` (CAP_NET_RAW/ALL), `--dns`/`--dns-search`/`--dns-domain`/`--no-dns`, `--init` (built-in signal-forward+reap — could replace baked tini), `--publish-socket host:container`, `--mount type=,source=,target=,readonly`, `--virtualization`, `--ssh` (forwards SSH agent — NOT the tailscale ssh server).

**Still to confirm with the egress prototype (needs the ephemeral tailnet key)**: real-tun tailscaled actually JOINS + the agent reaches metal by name over a real session, THEN the pf egress-narrowing (block non-tailscale, allow DERP-map IPs + control-plane) still keeps it joined. Entrypoint draft (pkgs/hermes-agent-image/entrypoint.sh) currently uses userspace-networking — switch to real-tun once the join+reach chain is confirmed (cheap entrypoint-layer rebuild). Egress pf allowlist source: live DERP map = 28 regions / 176 IPs.
